children: AMERICAN EAGLE reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 results with total net revenue of $1.38 billion, up 8% year-over-year, and operating income of $211 million versus $103 million a year earlier. Gross profit was $672 million with a 48.7% gross margin; the quarter included a $179 million net benefit from IEEPA tariff refunds. The company updated full-year 2026 operating income guidance to $540–$550 million, inclusive of the tariff refund benefit.
Total net revenue: $1,380,375 for the 13 weeks ended August 1, 2026 (up 8% vs. prior year).
Gross profit: $672,064; gross margin 48.7% (included $179 million net tariff refund benefit).
Operating income: $211,405 (15.3% operating margin) for the quarter, versus $103,085 (8.0%) prior year.
Net income attributable to AMERICAN EAGLE: $134,084 for the quarter; diluted EPS $0.79.
Updated Fiscal 2026 operating income outlook: $540 million to $550 million (guidance includes IEEPA tariff refunds).
Total comparable sales increased 6% in the quarter; Aerie comparable sales grew 19% while American Eagle comparable sales decreased 1%.
Aerie and OFFLINE combined revenue grew 25%, reflecting strong brand momentum and expansion efforts.
Inventory at cost rose 14% (units up 9%); company noted unit inventory rebalancing between brands and categories for the remainder of the year.
Operational actions tied to tariff refunds: the company received IEEPA tariff refunds of $196 million (including interest) and accrued incremental incentive compensation tied to those refunds.
Store footprint: total consolidated stores at end of period 1,167 (AE Brand 802; Aerie incl. OFFL/NE 335); Aerie continued openings during the period.
